init.title: Options Glovo
init.description: Leave the refresh token empty to keep the current one. LIVE ORDERING IS ADMIN-ONLY. allow_ordering permits only live preparation and may change the server basket/template; allow_live_checkout separately permits one paid submission. The provider-selected saved card and the exact authoritative total/currency must be explicitly confirmed immediately before submit. Ambiguous outcomes require manual Glovo checking and have no retry. Re-authentication resets these gates.

data.allow_ordering: Enable live ordering preparation (may change server basket/template)
data.ordering_acknowledged: I understand preparation can change the server basket/template, checkout is separately gated, and ambiguous outcomes have no retry
data.allow_live_checkout: Enable one live paid checkout submission
